author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Shared background service that performs one bounded Twitch clip metadata refresh for Random Clip Player, Clip Courier, and other approved clip consumers.
changelog: 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: initial shared cache release.

manifest.name: Clip Library Cache

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Clip Library Cache - Refresh

installationSteps: Install Clip Library Cache once when Random Clip Player, Clip Courier, or another installed add-on declares thsv.clip-library-cache as a dependency.
Import the matching Clip Library Cache Streamer.bot package. Keep Refresh enabled but triggerless; StreamBridge schedules it through the approved stable action ID.
In the wizard, approve only THSV Addon - Clip Library Cache - Refresh, enable the shared clip list, save, and restart StreamBridge.
Return to the consuming add-on. Clip Library Cache has no overlay and never plays, posts, or downloads a clip by itself.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling preserves only bounded clip metadata; no video files or signed playback URLs are stored.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded shared clip metadata refresh is available.
